verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו מֵאֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَدَعَا ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى وَكَلَّمَهُ مِنْ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ قَائِلًا:
verses.en: THE LORD called unto Moses, and spoke unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֥יב מִכֶּ֛ם קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן־הַבָּקָר֙ וּמִן־הַצֹּ֔אן תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת־קָרְבַּנְכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: إِذَا قَرَّبَ إِنْسَانٌ مِنْكُمْ قُرْبَانًا لِلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ، فَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ تُقَرِّبُونَ قَرَابِينَكُمْ.
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When any man of you bringeth an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd or of the flock.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, [even] of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

verses.he: אִם־עֹלָ֤ה קָרְבָּנֹו֙ מִן־הַבָּקָ֔ר זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶ֑נּוּ אֶל־פֶּ֝תַח אֹ֤הֶל מֹועֵד֙ יַקְרִ֣יב אֹתֹ֔ו לִרְצֹנֹ֖ו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ مُحْرَقَةً مِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ، فَذَكَرًا صَحِيحًا يُقَرِّبُهُ. إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ يُقَدِّمُهُ لِلرِّضَا عَنْهُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: If his offering be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall offer it a male without blemish; he shall bring it to the door of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.kjv: If his offering [be] a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.web: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

verses.he: וְסָמַ֣ךְ יָדֹ֔ו עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִרְצָ֥ה לֹ֖ו לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَيَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ، فَيُرْضَى عَلَيْهِ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْهُ.
verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.web: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־בֶּ֥ן הַבָּקָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠הִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן הֽ͏ַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וְזָרְק֨וּ אֶת־הַדָּ֤ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: وَيَذْبَحُ ٱلْعِجْلَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَيُقَرِّبُ بَنوُ هَارُونَ ٱلْكَهَنَةُ ٱلدَّمَ، وَيَرُشُّونَ ٱلدَّمَ مُسْتَدِيرًا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ ٱلَّذِي لَدَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall present the blood, and dash the blood round about against the altar that is at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that [is by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.en: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it into its pieces.
verses.kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.web: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

verses.he: וְ֠נָתְנוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֵ֖שׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל־הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُ بَنُو هَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ نَارًا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَيُرَتِّبُونَ حَطَبًا عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ.
verses.en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay wood in order upon the fire.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.web: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

verses.he: וְעָרְכ֗וּ בְּנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת הַנְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת־הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְאֶת־הַפָּ֑דֶר עַל־הָעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: وَيُرَتِّبُ بَنُو هَارُونَ ٱلْكَهَنَةُ ٱلْقِطَعَ مَعَ ٱلرَّأْسِ وَٱلشَّحْمِ فَوْقَ ٱلْحَطَبِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِي عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And Aaron's sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, and the head, and the suet, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar;
verses.kjv: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that [is] on the fire which [is] upon the altar:
verses.web: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

verses.he: וְקִרְבֹּ֥ו וּכְרָעָ֖יו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־הַכֹּל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖וחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ ס
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا أَحْشَاؤُهُ وَأَكَارِعُهُ فَيَغْسِلُهَا بِمَاءٍ، وَيُوقِدُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْجَمِيعَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُحْرَقَةً، وَقُودَ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash with water; and the priest shall make the whole smoke on the altar, for a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, [to be] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְאִם־מִן־הַצֹּ֨אן קָרְבָּנֹ֧ו מִן־הַכְּשָׂבִ֛ים אֹ֥ו מִן־הָעִזִּ֖ים לְעֹלָ֑ה זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَنَمِ ٱلضَّأْنِ أَوِ ٱلْمَعْزِ مُحْرَقَةً، فَذَكَرًا صَحِيحًا يُقَرِّبُهُ.
verses.en: And if his offering be of the flock, whether of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt-offering, he shall offer it a male without blemish.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if his offering [be] of the flocks, [namely], of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.web: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַ֨ט אֹתֹ֜ו עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ צָפֹ֖נָה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־דָּמֹ֛ו עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: وَيَذْبَحُهُ عَلَى جَانِبِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ إِلَى ٱلشِّمَالِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَيَرُشُّ بَنُو هَارُونَ ٱلْكَهَنَةُ دَمَهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.en: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD; and Aaron's sons, the priests, shall dash its blood against the altar round about.
verses.kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.web: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

verses.he: וְנִתַּ֤ח אֹתֹו֙ לִנְתָחָ֔יו וְאֶת־רֹאשֹׁ֖ו וְאֶת־פִּדְרֹ֑ו וְעָרַ֤ךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־הָֽעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: وَيُقَطِّعُهُ إِلَى قِطَعِهِ، مَعَ رَأْسِهِ وَشَحْمِهِ. وَيُرَتِّبُهُنَّ ٱلْكَاهِنُ فَوْقَ ٱلْحَطَبِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِي عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And he shall cut it into its pieces; and the priest shall lay them, with its head and its suet, in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar.
verses.kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that [is] on the fire which [is] upon the altar:
verses.web: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

verses.he: וְהַקֶּ֥רֶב וְהַכְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְרִ֨יב הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־הַכֹּל֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃ פ
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْأَحْشَاءُ وَٱلْأَكَارِعُ فَيَغْسِلُهَا بِمَاءٍ، وَيُقَرِّبُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْجَمِيعَ، وَيُوقِدُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ. إِنَّهُ مُحْرَقَةٌ، وَقُودُ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: But the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water; and the priest shall offer the whole, and make it smoke upon the altar; it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring [it] all, and burn [it] upon the altar: it [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְאִ֧ם מִן־הָעֹ֛וף עֹלָ֥ה קָרְבָּנֹ֖ו לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֣יב מִן־הַתֹּרִ֗ים אֹ֛ו מִן־בְּנֵ֥י הַיֹּונָ֖ה אֶת־קָרְבָּנֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ لِلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ مُحْرَقَةً، يُقَرِّبُ قُرْبَانَهُ مِنَ ٱلْيَمَامِ أَوْ مِنْ أَفْرَاخِ ٱلْحَمَامِ.
verses.en: And if his offering to the LORD be a burnt-offering of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD [be] of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.web: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִיבֹ֤ו הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמָלַק֙ אֶת־רֹאשֹׁ֔ו וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְנִמְצָ֣ה דָמֹ֔ו עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: يُقَدِّمُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ إِلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَيَحُزُّ رَأْسَهُ، وَيُوقِدُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَيُعْصَرُ دَمُهُ عَلَى حَائِطِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and pinch off its head, and make it smoke on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be drained out on the side of the altar.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn [it] on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.web: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

verses.he: וְהֵסִ֥יר אֶת־מֻרְאָתֹ֖ו בְּנֹצָתָ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜הּ אֵ֤צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֵ֔דְמָה אֶל־מְקֹ֖ום הַדָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَيَنْزِعُ حَوْصَلَتَهُ بِفَرْثِهَا وَيَطْرَحُهَا إِلَى جَانِبِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ شَرْقًا إِلَى مَكَانِ ٱلرَّمَادِ.
verses.en: And he shall take away its crop with the feathers thereof, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
verses.kjv: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.web: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

verses.he: וְשִׁסַּ֨ע אֹתֹ֣ו בִכְנָפָיו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתֹ֤ו הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֑שׁ עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃ ס
verses.ar: وَيَشُقُّهُ بَيْنَ جَنَاحَيْهِ. لَا يَفْصِلُهُ. وَيُوقِدُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ فَوْقَ ٱلْحَطَبِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ. إِنَّهُ مُحْرَقَةٌ، وَقُودُ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And he shall rend it by the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder; and the priest shall make it smoke upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire; it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, [but] shall not divide [it] asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that [is] upon the fire: it [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
